disposition_reason: Table 1 prints one lead, arsenic and cadmium value (mg/kg) by XRF for the flesh of each of two tilapia species from the oil-polluted Bodo River.

study.design: Small field survey of two wild tilapia species in an oil-polluted river
study.origin: Bodo River (Numuu tekuru), Bodo community, Gokana LGA, Ogoniland, Rivers State, Nigeria
study.market: Caught from the river, not bought
study.method: Oven drying at 110 °C, pressed pellets, XRF (Spectro X-LabPro) per USEPA 6200
study.qa: Calibration stored with certified reference materials; no recovery data

findings.notes: One value per species from five table-size fish; the paper does not say whether it is a pooled or mean value. Flesh was oven-dried at 110 °C before XRF; the table does not state the weight basis.

unresolved: Abstract gives cadmium 0.6-2 mg/kg, while Table 1 and the discussion give 0.6-1.7 mg/kg; Table 1 values are used.
Weight basis (dry vs wet) is not stated although samples were oven-dried before XRF.
No detection limits, replicates or dispersion are reported; mercury was not measured.
